notes.title: Hellslinger Dev Blog
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone! So, we’ve been very quiet for a long while, both here and on socials, but worry not: we’re still working hard on Hellslinger! So here’s where we’re at and how we got there:[/p][p]We've made the decision to do some hard work now to prevent lots of potential issues and convert the entire code base over to ZSCRIPT. Most of the enemies and weapons in the demo use the much clunkier DECORATE which did the job but it was becoming increasingly difficult to add new stuff. So in the name of not having tech debt, an entirely new code base has been created.[/p][p]Bad news? This takes a lot of time. Good new? The hard stuff is almost done. The core weapons and enemies for the first 5-6 maps in the main game are almost done which means the real meat and potatoes work of level design is about to properly crank up. While waiting for the resources to be in a good state we've planned out all 10(ish) maps planned for early access. [/p][p]Beyond the programming side of things, we’ve been working extensively on new visual assets for the game, including plenty of new textures, props, enemies (bosses included!), the 4th playable character (whose identity is secret for now) - and more! And as a treat, here's some of that sexy work[/p][p]New guns[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954919/bdb793d01baa052adb243df14b323b63d598a0e2.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954919/62a88bc46e3911bedb61b368f115f19acabe51cd.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954919/161b0fad60e275441638fece000cdf14db60542d.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Plague Doctor[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954919/924303fdc7935d4398522d72abc28a1ffa95150a.gif"][/img][/p][p]A little boss reveal, as a treat[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954919/8c7e8b396874d21a3a21598a17573c64c26009aa.gif"][/img][/p][p]Rest assured, we’re still going strong! We hope to have things to show on socials in the coming months. Please be sure to follow us on Bluesky as we are not updating our Twitter. We can’t wait to show you what we’re working on - thanks so much for your patience![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Character Reveal: Gaucha
notes.content:
Meet the latest character for Hellslinger: Gaucha!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42954919/ebfbe6edc74eca12d00f6e027921c7c7ed748865.png[/img]

Gaucha is an Argentinian-American rabbit, 35 years old. Of volatile personality, charismatic and astute, Gaucha is hard to deal with if she doesn’t like you. A professional mercenary, she picks her jobs carefully to ensure she’ll only kill scum. Carpe diem is her motto: if she’s not on a mission she’s partying hard and living each day like it's her last, which is always a possibility in her chosen profession. 
Her training is extensive, founded on more than half a decade with the US army. She is multidisciplinary when it comes to weapon usage but she is particularly fond of blowing up anything and everything with satchel charges. Nothing more satisfying than turning everything to ash with the flick of a switch.

Check out what she brings to the party with the full reveal trailer!

notes.title: Small demo update and future plans
notes.content:
First of all, we’d like to thank everyone for giving the Hellslinger demo a chance and supporting the project. Your feedback has helped us pinpoint the areas we want to focus on, and despite the long road ahead, things are looking bright. 

With this update, the demo is receiving an adjustment to the movement code aimed at addressing the “slippery” physics – gone are the days of platforming on ice, and we’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts! This is the only major change being updated or added to the demo for now, but we feel a significant enough one worthy of mention.

With the dust settling we took a moment to reevaluate things, and reach a consensus on the path moving forward. Considerable work has already gone into re-balancing characters, refining combat, and filling out the enemy roster. During this time, our Sound Designer / Composer “Lean” found themselves needing to step away from the project for personal reasons, as well. They have left on great terms, and thankfully we have since welcomed Relentless Frontier’s lead developer “Korzodin” into the fold, who has gallantly taken on the new Sound Design position for Hellslinger. At this point, our team is laser focused on development of the full campaign.

The demo won’t be forgotten about, but a new demo will likely replace the current one eventually, featuring the kind of combat, characters, level design, and story-telling we’re aiming for. Until then, we appreciate the continued love and support, and for now, we’re going to focus on simply making the best damn game that we can. 

Here’s a tiny peak at Veronika absolutely wrecking shop with her Godhand & Dual Auto-Shotguns, as well as a glimpse at our third playable character.
